name: Barzillai
overview: Barzillai the Gileadite is depicted as a faithful and generous supporter of King David during a time of hardship, providing food and sustenance to David and his weary followers in the wilderness. Despite his advanced age, Barzillai personally accompanied the king across the Jordan River, demonstrating his loyalty and honor. He is also recognized as a significant figure, noted as a friend of David, the father of Adriel, and a priest, underscoring his important role in the community and in the king's life.
